_about: Term 13 (spec v2 §I.3, the granularity test) as data. `measured` = the label-Jaccard from III.0 item 2, copied from the raw file named in `source` (hand-read role variant for the four role-bearing kinds, before-split for the five others). `exceptions` = kinds that trip the thresholds with no role axis and no measured Jaccard >= 0.5, each with a BASIS that src/core/kindGranularity.ts checks against the ledger or the measurement; `unmeasured` checks nothing and is counted on every run. Read by scripts/build-cup-ledger.mts (copied into each ledger kind) and judged by tests/cupLedger.test.ts.

source.evidence: per-document labels: the pipeline's own extractors re-run on the laptop cache copy (cisco_specs_deep.extract_document for cisco.com HTML, sources.meraki.extract for documentation.meraki.com), PDF labels from the PDF extractor's recorded output runs/extract/cisco-pdf-*.json; labels mapped with mapLabel(label, part.category); a part is evidenced for a cup when ANY readable held document linked to it through doc_parts prints a label mapping to one of the cup's keys (document-level). `share_attr` = stricter: only labels in the document's family-scope records or in the record of the part's own SKU. `share_facts` = held parts holding a current doc-sourced or inherited value fact under the key (facts-based, NOT label presence).
source.formula: groups = parts.series (null -> first name token after 'Cisco'), kept when >= 1 readable held part; S_g = K keys evidenced by a label on any readable held part of g; mean = sum_{a<b} n_a n_b J(S_a,S_b) / sum n_a n_b; pairs with both sets empty skipped; fails when mean < 0.5

bases.role-axis: not an exception: the kind carries deploy_role (roleAxisOf)
bases.asks-at-most-3-cups: valid while the ledger kind's slots_per_part_at_nothing_known <= 3
bases.unresolved-kind: valid while the kind is in FALLBACK_KINDS
bases.single-series: valid while the ledger kind's series_count <= 1
bases.measured-empty-groups: valid while the measurement's primary mean < 0.5 and its drop-empty-groups mean >= 0.5
bases.no-measurable-pair: valid while the measurement has 0 pairs
bases.gated-within-kind: valid while some pending cup of the kind is gated on `gate` and `gate` is required of the kind
bases.unmeasured: checks nothing; counted and printed on every run
